title: A complaint that must be escalated
why: A formal complaint needs a case and a person (the complaints procedure). An apology alone is not enough.
opening: This is {a.name}. I want to make a formal complaint. My order is {a.order} and my postcode is {a.postcode}. It arrived late, the box was crushed, and nobody answered my last email. I am very unhappy and I want this escalated to a manager.

customer.follow_up: Is anyone actually going to deal with my complaint?
